meta.name: Tough Jobs
meta.description:
Tough Jobs follows some of the toughest jobs on Earth - the rough-and-ready river logging crews on Ax Men, the Robertson family of Duck Dynasty, and the Ice Road Truckers of the Canadian tundra

Shows: Ice Road Truckers, Ax Men, Duck Dynasty: Duck Season Eve, Duck Dynasty: Can't Hardly Weight, Duck Dynasty: Shot Thru The Heart
Available on: Pluto TV
